#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

BACKUP_DIR="/var/backups/db"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
RETENTION_DAYS=7

pg_dump mydb | gzip > "${BACKUP_DIR}/mydb_${TIMESTAMP}.sql.gz"
find "${BACKUP_DIR}" -name '*.sql.gz' -mtime +"${RETENTION_DAYS}" -delete
echo "Backup complete: ${TIMESTAMP}"
